title: Who can apply (ukri.org)
text:
This opportunity is open to organisations on the standard eligibility list.
It is not open to organisations based overseas.
To apply, you must be:
the project lead (or the fellow, if applying for a fellowship)
based at an organisation eligible for UKRI funding and have their support
resident in the UK when you apply, or will be resident in the UK for the duration of the project
This opportunity is open to applicants who meet the individual eligibility criteria .
Building on the Technician Commitment UKRI Action Plan and the UKRI people and teams action plan , we particularly encourage the inclusion of research technical professionals in the ‘Core team’ section. Where appropriate, we encourage applications that include research technical professionals as project lead (PL) or project co-leads (PcLs). UKRI’s individual eligibility policy focuses on individuals’ talent, skills and capability rather than formal qualifications, and recognises expertise developed through academic and non-academic routes.
You can only apply as PL on one submitted application. You can be PcL on multiple applications.
You must also check to make sure you meet all of UKRI’s individual eligibility criteria .
Equality, diversity and inclusion
We are committed to equal opportunity for all funding applicants and encourage applications from a diverse range of researchers.
Who else can be involved
Although businesses are not eligible to be included as PL or PcL, they are strongly encouraged to be involved as project partners.
Demand management
We are not currently limiting application numbers for this funding opportunity, but if we get more applications than we can assess, we may start to limit numbers.
Resubmissions
We will not accept uninvited resubmissions of projects that have been submitted to us before. A resubmission is an application that only has minor changes to a previous submission.
